slides.headline: what to say when they keep canceling your one on one
name the pattern, not just today
slides.sub: “you’ve moved our one on one a few times now.” keep it plain. don’t pile on.

slides.headline: say why it matters
slides.sub: “when it keeps getting bumped, it gets hard to use this time well.” now they know this is not about your calendar.

slides.headline: ask the real question
slides.sub: “is this time still workable, or do we need a new one?” don’t beg for scraps of time.

slides.headline: set the new bar
slides.sub: “if we keep this slot, i need us to treat it as set.” kind and clear can live in the same sentence.

slides.headline: have you been letting this slide too?

caption:
if they keep moving your one on one, don’t call it a small thing. it changes what your time with them means.

save this for the next time you’re tempted to let it slide.
